cohort: Pregnant women with PsA (n=117), AS (n=129), and healthy controls (n=717) enrolled in the Organization of Teratology Information Specialists Autoimmune Disease Project from 2004 to 2018
finding: Women with PsA and AS have an increased risk for specific adverse pregnancy outcomes, particularly when disease activity is high or glucocorticoids are used.
mod_finding: Women with PsA were at increased risk for cesarean delivery, and in women with AS, a high RAPID3 score was also associated with cesarean delivery.
